messages:
ryan.f: Heads-up - BlueShore Analytics sent invoice BSA-527 for EUR 9,800. Our PO 5090 is in USD and AP is flagging a mismatch. PDF: https://files.redwood/blueshore/BSA-527.pdf

natalie-finops: Thanks Ryan. AP error says currency mismatch + VAT line present. Our vendor record is VAT-exempt (US based). BlueShore invoice shows VAT 20% (they billed from Ireland).

cleo.proc: Weird, procurement shows vendor address in US. I think vendor recently changed legal entity to BlueShore EU Ltd. Did they switch billing entity?

procurement-bot: Purchase order 5090 linked to SOW #21. PO currency: USD. Vendor record: BLUE SHORE ANALYTICS LLC (EIN on file). No active EU entity on file.

ryan.f: The engineering team approved SOW billables; we expected USD conversion. Vendor emailed saying they default to EUR for EMEA clients. They did not include our PO number.

natalie-finops: Two issues: 1) No PO number on invoice so AP can't match; 2) VAT applied incorrectly. Can't pay until resolved. Suggest asking vendor to reissue invoice in USD with PO included, or procurement issues a one-off PO in EUR and we handle FX. Which is faster?

cleo.proc: I'll ping vendor legal and ask for confirmation of billing entity. If they are BlueShore EU, we need their W-8/B-9 equivalent. If not, request reissue in USD.

procurement-bot: Created expedited PO draft 5711 (EUR) and assigned approver @ceo-finance for review. Link: https://proc.redwood/purchase/5711

natalie-finops: Hold payment. AP put invoice BSA-527 on hold at 2026-08-02 10:15 UTC. Reconciliation blocked until vendor confirms PO or reissues. Approvals-bot, note hold please.

approvals-bot: Payment hold set on invoice BSA-527 by natalie-finops at 2026-08-02 10:17 UTC. Hold reason: currency and tax mismatch. Suggested actions: vendor reissue with PO or procurement-approved EUR PO.

ryan.f: I messaged BlueShore contacts this morning asking for a USD invoice with PO 5090. They responded "can reissue but need billing contact" and asked for tax documents for EU billing.

cleo.proc: Vendor sent an email confirming EU entity exists but can bill from US entity if requested. They attached a quick attestation. Forwarding to legal for quick check.

natalie-finops: If legal signs off that US billing is valid, AP can accept USD invoice with PO 5090 and remove VAT. If vendor insists on EUR, then PO 5711 needs approval. Which path is quicker?

cleo.proc: Legal replied: attestation ok for one-off. We can ask vendor to reissue USD invoice. I'll request reissue now and ask them to include PO 5090 and remove VAT.

procurement-bot: PO 5711 status: PENDING APPROVAL by ceo-finance (auto-created as contingency).

approvals-bot: Notification sent to ceo-finance for PO 5711 at 2026-08-02 11:02 UTC.

ryan.f: Vendor uploaded reissued invoice BSA-527-US.pdf at 11:28. It shows USD 10,870 and includes PO 5090, VAT removed. Link: https://files.redwood/blueshore/BSA-527-US.pdf

natalie-finops: Verified new invoice matches PO 5090 and GL mapping `6105` (data services). AP matched and scheduled for next payment run. Removed hold at 11:35.

ap-team: Confirmed payment scheduled. Note: FX variance created a small rounding diff ($70). We'll absorb to cost center eng-platform.

cleo.proc: Closing loop with vendor to update vendor record to BLUE SHORE ANALYTICS LLC (billing entity). Added vendor note to procurement system: "prefer USD billing, include PO on all invoices".

ryan.f: Thanks all. Please confirm once payment posted so we can close the SOW. :thumbsup:
